conventions.note: Measured rule: on a square canvas only NxN grids (1x1, 2x2, 3x3, 4x4) have square cells. A 2x4 grid has 256x512 cells and cannot be locked to a 2x2 scale profile - hold its consistency with maxBodyScaleCv/maxAnchorYStd plus a sprite_anchor_guide instead. Exported sheets are normalised to square cellSize frames regardless.

assetSchema.groupNote: Each entry of `groups[]` has a `group` name that is both the directory under outputRoot and the `group` field emitted on every registry row. src/scenes/preload.ts loads a row only when its group is listed in the active slice's ART_GROUPS (re-exported by src/scenes/game.ts), and scripts/new-game.sh deletes the outputRoot directories of groups the chosen family does not list, then re-runs the generator. Adding art for a slice therefore means: a group here, exported sheets, AND the group name in that slice's ART_GROUPS. A group directory that is absent is treated as pruned on purpose (no rows emitted, aliases kept and flagged); a missing asset inside a present group stays a hard error.
assetSchema.scaleProfileNote: Group-level `scaleProfile` is a path the sprite-forge export writes to and reads back, not an input file this repo ships: it appears only after the group's `writeScaleProfile: true` asset (the base action) has been exported, and every later action of that group is then generated against it with the drift gates (see .claude/skills/game-art references/prompt-contract.md). A checkout with no exported base action has no such file yet - that is expected, nothing in src/ or scripts/ reads it.
assetSchema.note: Per-asset fields consumed by scripts/gen-art-registry.mjs. Everything the engine needs comes from either sprite-metadata.json (measured) or these fields (curated) - nothing is hand-baked in src/data/art.ts.
assetSchema.id: Directory name under outputRoot/<group>/<id>/. Also the default texture/animation key.
assetSchema.key: Optional. Overrides the emitted Phaser texture key when it differs from `id` (e.g. props are namespaced 'prop-<id>').
assetSchema.kind: 'body' | 'fx' | 'ui' | 'bg' - documentation only, does not drive registry shape.
assetSchema.facesRight: Optional, default true. false records that the unflipped art faces left; emitted only when false.
assetSchema.baseAction: Optional, true on exactly one asset per multi-action group. Its sprite-metadata.json outputSubjectHeightMean becomes the group's reference height; every sibling gets `scale = baseHeight / thisHeight` so switching actions does not resize the character.
assetSchema.loop: Optional, default true. Whether the generated Phaser animation repeats.
assetSchema.duration: Optional. Overrides sprite-metadata.json's output.durationMs as the animation's ms-per-frame. Set to 0 on a multi-frame sheet that must NOT get an animation (e.g. icon sheets addressed by frame index).
assetSchema.textureAlias: Optional. Adds `TEXTURE.<alias> = '<key>'` for an asset gameplay code addresses by a stable name instead of the raw key.
assetSchema.animAlias: Optional. Adds `ANIM.<alias> = '<key>'` for a multi-frame asset gameplay code plays by a named animation constant.
assetSchema.icons: Optional string[] on an icon sheet. Index = frame number; each name adds `ICON.<name> = { key: '<key>', frame: <index> }`.

qcExceptions.reason: strict:false, passed:false (output-edge-touch): the full-bleed 2:3 backdrop is allowed to touch the canvas edge by design (it is meant to fill the frame edge-to-edge, not sit inside a safe margin). 1 retry was spent on the edge-touch failure; kept the asset rather than shrinking the subject, which would leave a visible border in-game.

strict:false, passed:false (background-contamination, output-edge-touch): a seamless tile is expected to fill and touch every edge of its cell so the TileSprite wrap shows no seam; both failures are inherent to a full-bleed seamless tile, not defects.

integration.keys: Phaser texture key equals the asset's `key` (default: its `id`); animation key equals the texture key, with frames from the processed sprite sheet.
